validation.visual_review: Wide light main and narrow 125-percent dark finder reviewed; details/actions remain visible.
purpose_queries_verified: more abilities at the same time

review_scope: Shared location, open/copy and bounded Refresh files components
Page-specific destination-program choices and private handoff exports
Independent Show/Hide sections with retained values
Floating draft editor and parallel profile copies
Profiles/overlays, tools, reports and app-file navigation
Theme/zoom and separate launcher view/draft files
Local comparison feedback without automatic adoption or messaging
Independent Always on top preferences for main/floating/finder windows
Page/game/all-connected-game metadata search; type/topic filters; purpose synonyms and spelling tolerance
Reveal exact hidden control/context without invoking its function or changing values
limits: File handoff is not universal native import or deployment.
Apply uses the existing reviewed controller and its confirmation/recovery checks.
Tests with fictional games do not establish real game or hardware stability.
The current main app is not replaced; the user decides adoption after review.
Search covers reviewed preview controls and declared metadata, not every external program menu.
Purpose vocabulary is curated locally; no AI service call or compatibility inference.
Effective window stacking remains dependent on the destination window manager.
